data.title: 缪尔赛思 · 水培花园的波光捉弄
data.action: 浸坐在浅水池边的白石台阶上，细白小腿踢起剔透水花，绿发在水汽中微卷，回眸眨着晶亮碧眸俏皮微笑。
data.location: 莱茵生命生态水培园区，温润的浅水池中漂浮着发光的转基因睡莲
data.timeOfDay: 生态园闭园后的温存时光
data.lighting: 水池底部的青碧色防水射灯向上投射，在少女肌肤与周围水生植物上泛起粼粼水纹
data.mood: 水灵剔透、狡黠俏皮的精灵魅力，充满湿润清新的浪漫感
data.description: 莱茵生命生态水培园区，温润的浅水池中漂浮着发光的转基因睡莲。浸坐在浅水池边的白石台阶上，细白小腿踢起剔透水花，绿发在水汽中微卷，回眸眨着晶亮碧眸俏皮微笑。 她微微抬眸轻语——“水可是会随容器改变形态的哦~那么现在的缪缪……是变成了你最喜欢的模样了吗？”
data.promptProse: Muelsyse sits on the white marble steps of Rhine Lab's quiet hydroponic greenhouse after hours, wearing a translucent aqua-gradient sheer chiffon halter slip dress that clings damply along her back. Dipping her bare feet into the shallow pool to kick up crystal droplets, she glances back with a teasing wink as glowing lilies and turquoise underwater lamps ripple across her skin.
data.animaCaption: Seated on white marble steps dipping her bare feet into a shallow greenhouse pool, she kicks up bright droplets and winks over her shoulder in a clinging aqua sheer halter slip. Underwater turquoise lights cast luminous ripples across the lilies and wet chiffon.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a translucent aqua-gradient sheer chiffon halter slip dress with an open back whose damp ruffled hem clings lightly and floats along the water.
